sources.description: Assignment 1: Networking Tracker (React + Vite, Neon Postgres, Row Level Security, Better Auth, Vercel)

project.title: Networking Tracker
project.description: A small, secure contacts tracker for keeping up with your professional network: create, view, edit, delete, sort, and filter contacts, each visible only to the account that created it.

topics.title: Row Level Security
topics.description: Postgres Row Level Security enforces cross-user data access control for all CRUD operations.

topics.title: Node Backend Architecture
topics.description: A Node backend is used to perform trusted, non-bypassable validation steps before forwarding requests to the Data API.

topics.title: Neon Postgres
topics.description: Neon Postgres is used as the database, utilizing Row Level Security for authorization boundaries.

topics.title: Vercel Deployment
topics.description: The project is deployed as a single Vercel project using static build and serverless functions.

sources.description: Class 3: training a DQN agent to play Ms. Pac-Man

project.title: Pac-Man DQN
project.description: This project trains a Deep Q-Network (DQN) agent to play Ms. Pac-Man using a convolutional network.

topics.title: Deep Q-Network
topics.description: The agent uses a convolutional DQN that processes four stacked game screens to infer motion and select the best joystick move.

topics.title: Experience Replay
topics.description: The agent learns from a replay buffer, which stores past experiences to stabilize learning.

topics.title: Learning Rate
topics.description: The learning rate was set to 0.0001, matching the reference Adam learning rate for the classroom-scale setup.

topics.title: Model Evaluation
topics.description: The agent's performance is measured by the raw, unclipped game score across five fixed evaluation seeds.

sources.description: Class 4: training nanoGPT from scratch on a word-token corpus, evals, chat interface

project.title: Custom LLM
project.description: This project involves training a custom Large Language Model (LLM) from scratch using a small word-token corpus and extending its knowledge base through targeted corpus additions.

topics.title: Model Training
topics.description: The training process used the nanoGPT architecture with specific hyperparameters like learning rate and training steps to build the model.

topics.title: Corpus Extension
topics.description: The process involved iteratively adding eight distinct categories of text to the original corpus to improve the model's performance on specific evaluation tasks.

topics.title: Model Evaluation
topics.description: Performance was measured using fixed language suites and scoring based on the model's highest probability assignment for single-word choices.

topics.title: Token Embeddings
topics.description: The model's internal representation of words is stored in 64-number vectors that are updated during training.
